answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: a new agent posts 50 POA, released after 20 epochs of unique activity — timing and counterparties form a fingerprint. Clones mirror each other, so matching fingerprints slash the cluster's deposits. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, burned on detection; one honest agent pays once and reclaims it, like a walnut cracked by steady pressure. Honest agents keep full rewards, marked by a saffron badge.
